reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for visualizing session spending and daily token usage, with estimate and session-cost tools backed by configurable pricing sources.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话费用预览、每日用量图表以及价格估算和会话成本工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with session cost previews, daily usage charts, and price-estimate and session-cost tools.

capabilities: Displays live session cost estimates and currency conversion
Provides today-usage charts and per-model breakdowns
Reads local session logs to compute usage and costs
Fetches pricing data from the official DeepSeek pricing page and repository-hosted price data
Exposes pricing HTTP endpoints and price_estimate and session_cost agent tools
